component.name: Diary
component.summary: Write your diary, encrypted and in sync

description.p: A distraction-free diary. Each day is a plain Markdown file, encrypted with your password, in a folder you choose — put it in your online storage and your diary is backed up and available on every computer.

ul.li: Opens straight to today; dates are kept for you
Standard age encryption: readable without this app
Keeps both versions when two computers edit the same day
